cond_0001.intro: The Validation Engineer I provides support in performing equipment, facility and utility qualification activity and re-qualification activity to ensure compliance to cGMP and [Company name masked]'s quality requirements.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assist in the preparation/ execution of Installation Qualification(IQ)/Operational Qualification(OQ)/ Performance Qualification(PQ) protocols for equipment, facility and utilities as well as related software.
Help generate qualification report and help summarize the results which will be reviewed by the supervisor.
Performs re-qualification of equipment, facility and utilities as required under supervision.
Identify deviations encountered during IQ/OQ/PQ execution and work with supervisor to implement mitigation solution.
Draft Standard Operating Procedure(SOP) for new operational equipment.
Supports process validation and cleaning validation by providing product contact surface area, equipment qualification parameter ranges and challenge tests criteria to technical service.
Works with equipment vendors to collect equipment manual and other required documents.
Closely works with the maintenance & facility teams to complete new equipment installation as per project requirement.
Assist with engineering projects and performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Pharmaceutical manufacturing, Engineering, Science or relevant field
0-2 Years of experience in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Industry, or cGMP environment
Proficient in MS Office
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Ability to follow direction and execute assigned work independently, after initial training is completed
Preferred Requirements
1 Or more years of experience in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Industry, or cGMP environment
Excellent technical writing skills
Ability to work both independently and in conjunction with a team

cond_0159.intro: The Validation Engineer I provides support in performing equipment, facility and utility qualification activity and re-qualification activity to ensure compliance to cGMP and [Company name masked]'s quality requirements.
cond_0159.responsibilities:
Assist in the preparation and execution of Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols for equipment, facility and utilities as well as related software. Regularly connect with your supervisor to review qualification reports and summarize results.
Perform re-qualification of equipment, facility and utilities as required, working closely with your supervisor throughout.
Identify deviations encountered during IQ/OQ/PQ execution and actively communicate with your supervisor to implement mitigation solutions.
Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for new operational equipment.
Support process validation and cleaning validation by providing product contact surface area, equipment qualification parameter ranges and challenge test criteria to technical service, staying in regular contact with that team.
Work directly with equipment vendors to collect equipment manuals and other required documents.
Closely coordinate with the maintenance and facility teams on a daily basis to complete new equipment installation as per project requirements.
Assist with engineering projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Assist in the preparation and execution of Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols for equipment, facility and utilities as well as related software. Help generate qualification reports and summarize results, which will be reviewed by the supervisor.
Perform re-qualification of equipment, facility and utilities as required, working closely under supervision.
Identify deviations encountered during IQ/OQ/PQ execution and actively work with your supervisor to discuss and implement mitigation solutions.
Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for new operational equipment.
Support process validation and cleaning validation by communicating product contact surface area, equipment qualification parameter ranges and challenge test criteria to technical service.
Stay in regular contact with equipment vendors to collect equipment manuals and other required documents.
Work closely and on an ongoing basis with the maintenance and facility teams to complete new equipment installation as per project requirements.
Assist with engineering projects and perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0276.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Engineering, Science, or a relevant field.
0–2 Years of experience in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Industry, or a cGMP environment.
Proficient in MS Office.
Ability to follow direction and execute assigned work independently after initial training.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Requirements
1 Or more years of experience in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Industry, or a cGMP environment.
Strong technical writing skills.
Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain findings and walk supervisors or team members through results.

cond_0305.intro: The Validation Engineer I takes ownership of equipment, facility, and utility qualification and re-qualification activities to ensure compliance with cGMP and [Company name masked]'s quality requirements.
cond_0305.responsibilities:
Execute Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols for equipment, facility, utilities, and related software.
Deliver qualification reports and summarize results for supervisor review.
Lead re-qualification of equipment, facility, and utilities as required under supervision.
Identify deviations during IQ/OQ/PQ execution and drive mitigation solutions in coordination with the supervisor.
Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for new operational equipment.
Drive process validation and cleaning validation support by providing product contact surface area, equipment qualification parameter ranges, and challenge test criteria to technical service.
Manage collection of equipment manuals and required documents from equipment vendors.
Lead coordination with maintenance and facility teams to complete new equipment installation per project requirements.
Contribute to engineering projects and carry out other duties as assigned.

Excellent oral and written communication skills - Intermediate

Assist in the preparation and execution of Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols for equipment, facility and utilities as well as related software. Regularly connect with your supervisor to review qualification reports and summarize results.
Perform re-qualification of equipment, facility and utilities as required, working closely with your supervisor throughout.
Identify deviations encountered during IQ/OQ/PQ execution and actively communicate with your supervisor to implement mitigation solutions.
Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for new operational equipment.
Support process validation and cleaning validation by providing product contact surface area, equipment qualification parameter ranges and challenge test criteria to technical service, staying in regular contact with that team.
Work directly with equipment vendors to collect equipment manuals and other required documents.
Closely coordinate with the maintenance and facility teams on a daily basis to complete new equipment installation as per project requirements.
Assist with engineering projects and perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0321.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Engineering, Science or relevant field.
0-2 Years of experience in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Industry, or a cGMP environment with a Bachelor's degree.
1 Year or more of experience in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Industry, or a cGMP environment with a Bachelor's degree.
Proficient in MS Office (Advanced).
Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to clearly communicate findings in writing (Intermediate).
Good oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain results and clarify requirements when working with others (Intermediate).
Able to follow direction and carry out assigned work independently after initial training (Intermediate).
Able to work both independently and as part of a team, actively contributing in group settings (Advanced).
cond_0321.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
cond_0321.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.
